h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tiruppur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tiruppur

items.pText: Tiruppur's knitwear exporters care a great deal about colour, and the same people often ask whether a playground for their school, staff colony or family property can match a set palette. It can. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment in more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,030 km from Tiruppur.

Tiruppur lies in the dry western belt of Tamil Nadu, close to Coimbatore, with hot summers and modest rain. Garment units, schools run by business families and new apartment projects all buy play equipment here. Delivery is by road from Vasai, and installation is handled by our team or a south Indian dealer. Send us your colour references with the site size, and we will suggest a colour scheme from our shades along with the layout drawing.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Matching playground colours to a brand or building

c: Start with two or three main colours from your building or logo and use them on the larger parts, such as roofs, slides and panels. Keep one bright accent for handholds and steps so children can see them clearly. Colours that are too close to each other look flat outdoors. Ask us for the nearest match from our shade range.
Darker shades heat up faster in Tiruppur's sun, so use them on panels and keep slide beds lighter. Colour and design customisation is available on request across our

items.q: Do dark colours get too hot in the sun?
items.a: They heat up faster than light shades. Use darker colours on panels and roofs, and keep slide beds and seats in lighter shades or in shade.
